description: This file contains server-side logic for the 'TheorySet' page of an online examination system. It manages course and semester selection, question management for theory questions, and navigation between pages. It interacts directly with the database to add questions, set exam details, and update question numbers based on course and semester selections.

classes.name: TheorySet
classes.description: Code-behind class for the TheorySet ASP.NET page handling question management and navigation in the online exam system.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Event handler for page load; currently commented out but typically used to initialize page state.

methods.description: Handles redirect to AdminPanel.aspx when Home button is clicked.

methods.description: Handles redirect to AdminQueue.aspx when Profile button is clicked.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles redirect to AdminLeaderboard.aspx when Leaderboard button is clicked.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown based on selected semester.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Inserts a new theory question into the database and updates the question number.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Sets details for a course exam and inserts them into the database.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to login page for logout.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
